text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Furioso-san. Please, eat 
your fill.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
These are clam chowder croquettes packed 
with Japanese mustard spinach and hard 
clams~

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is from that famous Funabashi...! 
Wait, wasn't it completely sold out 
online...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
D-Did you actually recreate it?! That's 
amazing! Thank—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
N-No! However, that flavor isn't something 
that can be replicated so easily. It will 
never match the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? Don't underestimate me, Furio. 
Where do you think I got this recipe from?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Freshly fried and so delicious. The folks 
on the manufacturing team were so warm 
too... You have such a wonderful hometown, 
Furioso-san.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, if we're gonna do it, might as well 
go all out with the details.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. I just... couldn't 
help myself.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Just the aroma alone brings back memories 
of home. ...I will gratefully accept this.
